select bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as merge_code, bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.batch_no as batchno, bm_product_formula.name as bom_name, bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.plan_date as plandate, bm_weigh_centre.name as weigh_centre_name, bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.release_status as releasestatus, bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.remark from bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group left join bm_weigh_centre on bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.weigh_centre_id = bm_weigh_centre.id and bm_weigh_centre.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material on bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_product_formula_version on bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.bom_version_id = bm_product_formula_version.id and bm_product_formula_version.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_product_formula on bm_product_formula_version.product_formula_id = bm_product_formula.id and bm_product_formula.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.is_deleted = 0 and bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.weigh_centre_id in
#{item}
AND bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{page.batchNo}, '%')
AND bm_material.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{page.materialName}, '%')
AND bm_material.merge_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{page.mergeCode}, '%')
AND bm_product_formula.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{page.bomName}, '%')
order by bm_weigh_ticket_requirement_group.create_time desc
